prose.subject: URGENT: Updated NEAR Payout Details for INV-91942
prose.body:
Hi Omar,

Hope you’re having a good week. I’m reaching out because our finance team just migrated our treasury operations to a new wallet infrastructure. This is a time-sensitive update, so please note the changes below.

Your pending invoice INV-91942 (1435.86 USDC) is currently queued for release. However, due to the migration, all incoming payments must now be directed to our new verified account. The previous address will be deprecated by end of day, so please ensure you update your records immediately to avoid any processing delays or manual reconciliation on our end.

New Payout Account:
ivybridgeanalyitcs14.testnet

Could you please confirm once the transfer has been initiated? If you haven’t already paid this invoice, please use the address above. I’ve attached the updated vendor form for your files.

Apologies for the last-minute change! Our team is pushing hard to complete this migration today, so any quick confirmation from your side would be greatly appreciated. Let me know if you have any questions or need the transaction hash for your records.

Best regards,

Hana Kowal
Senior Accounts Payable Manager
Ivybridge Analytics
